name: Queue Dine
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Tap the ticket machine to make the first customer leave. Tap the trash can and drive away the next customer with the smell.
Tap the tea barrel to spill tea and clear the couple.
Tap the arcade machine to scare away more customers.
Tap the phone and play the voice message to make the couple leave.
Drag the large knife to cut the menu price tag and clear the last customer.
